title: Plus Size Tiered Tulle Lace Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Elevate your wedding guest look with this stunning Plus Size Tiered Tulle Lace Dress! Featuring delicate lace detailing and a playful tiered tulle skirt, this dress offers a flattering silhouette that moves beautifully. Perfect for dancing the night away or enjoying a romantic outdoor ceremony!


Tips: Prioritize the bust measurement when selecting, the fabric is highly elastic and can stretch by at least 2 inches. Consider the waist measurement next, and disregard the hip measurement.

 

Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises lace.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
